findings.summary: Removed [650, 1168] from SUPPORTED_AD_SIZES, causing bid requests for that ad size to be rejected by isBidRequestValid when they were previously accepted
findings.failure_scenario: A publisher has ad slots of size 650x1168 configured for the condorx bidder. Since [650, 1168] is no longer in SUPPORTED_AD_SIZES, isValidAdSize([650, 1168]) returns false, isBidRequestValid returns false, and the bid request is dropped silently — no bids are returned for that ad slot. The engageya adapter in the same codebase still lists [650, 1168] as a supported size, confirming this is a real ad dimension in use.
